# OpenRouter Provider Context

## Available Workflow Prompts

Refer to [`.github/local/prompts-guide.md`](../local/prompts-guide.md) for the
catalog of all workflow prompts in `.github/prompts/`, their trigger phrases,
purposes, and relationships. This guide is the equivalent of `routing.md` for
the prompt collection and enables correct prompt selection when a user request
maps to a defined workflow command.
